title: Preferred longitudes of Conway tree complements
status: Draft; rational squared longitude, original framing and anchored negative lift, including strict bare junctions and their classical meridian action
imports: Original marked all-circle representation and filled meridian germ from Nonparabolic holonomy of trees of crossing circles, Theorems 1.1, 1.2 and 3.1 and Proposition 6.1.

Original strict positive geometry and independently long signed primitive fillings from Marked geometry of strict Conway compositions, Theorems 1.2–1.3 and Sections 6–8; original auxiliary disk marking from Positive octahedra and primitive fillings for trees of crossing circles, Proposition 2.1.

Strict stationary response from Stationary profiles of strict Newton trees, Theorem 3.3, Lemma 4.1 and Proposition 4.2; Newton turn/product identities and scalar factorial estimate from Newton coefficients and positive sources for Conway tangles, Proposition 3.2, Theorem 3.3 and Lemma 5.2.
Only the exact finite Fourier trace of Spectral estimates for Conway tangle sources, Lemma 6.1, is imported; its analytic color-loss theorem is not used.

The constant-field and all-fiber arguments, preferred cusp word, integer surgery shear, spin sign and zero-circle elimination are proved here. No quantum expansion, recurrence existence, full A-polynomial identity or volume limit is asserted.
scope: Typesetting, page count and declared imports only; not proof verification.
